q4_2018_selloff.name: Q4 2018 selloff
q4_2018_selloff.description: Rate-hike and growth scare. Stocks fell sharply into year-end 2018, with small caps hit hardest.
q4_2018_selloff.notes: Q4 2018 returns as reported by the source: S&P 500 -13.5% (used as the proxy for VTI) and Russell 2000 -20.2% (used for IWM). The source does not say whether these are price or total return.

covid_crash_2020.name: COVID crash (2020)
covid_crash_2020.description: The fastest 30%+ drop on record: February 19 peak to March 23 low.
covid_crash_2020.notes: S&P 500 close-to-close, 3,386.15 to 2,237.40 (-33.9%), used as the proxy for VTI. Only the market move was verified. Size and value effects are left for the analysis step to imply.

vaccine_rally_2020.name: Vaccine rally (Nov 2020)
vaccine_rally_2020.description: Vaccine news set off a broad rally, with small caps outrunning large caps and a rotation from growth to value.
vaccine_rally_2020.notes: November 2020: S&P 500 +10.95% (proxy for VTI) and Russell 2000 +18.43% (IWM). Sources describe the growth-to-value rotation but no monthly style returns were verified, so none are included.

rate_shock_2022.name: Rate shock (2022)
rate_shock_2022.description: Fed rate hikes. Growth stocks were hit far harder than value.
rate_shock_2022.notes: Calendar 2022: S&P 500 -18.11% (proxy for VTI), Russell 2000 -20.44% (IWM). IWD and IWF use the S&P 500 Value (-5.22%) and Growth (-29.41%) indices as proxies for the Russell 1000 style indices, so treat the style numbers as approximate. The source does not say whether returns are price or total.

tariff_shock_2025.name: Tariff shock (2025)
tariff_shock_2025.description: Tariff announcements triggered a sharp selloff from the February 19 peak to the April 8 low.
tariff_shock_2025.notes: S&P 500 close-to-close, 6,144.15 (Feb 19) to 4,982.77 (Apr 8), a -18.9% drop computed from the levels in the SIFMA report, used as the proxy for VTI. Intraday the drop reached -21.4% on Apr 7 per another source. No small-cap or style figures were verified.
